notes.title: Iragon v.1.0001
notes.content:
[b]Important for everyone that bought the game at previous price:[/b] We consulted with Steam on what can be done. They answered us saying that there is no way to compensate people who purchased at a higher price. They recommend that you issue a refund request (you will be refunded the original price you bought at) and then rebuy the game.

Hey everyone. We have a new patch with loads of bugfixes and improvements.

[b]Here are the full patch notes:[/b]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Esme/Mindee dead body to start of Post raid Village.
[*] Reworked Main Menu Music featuring the female vocalist Melethiel.
[*] Added missing hall of heroes names.
[*] Added a "received loot" notification in VR.
[*] Added boob physics to Spider Boss scene.
[*] Added textures and materials with snow effect.
[*] Adding Face anim to Brianna's Idle in Farmlands.
[*] Added a fade to black when exiting the game in VR.
[*] Added camera sensitivity setting as well as saving for other settings.
[*] Slider to adjust weapon and spell height in VR.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the scale of the VR weapons' impact particle.
[*] Moved UI elements so that they dont overlap and other UI fixes and optimizations.
[*] Mana regeneration rate increased.
[*] Health shard, mana shard, upgrade collectibles pull to player location accuracy improvement.
[*] Waypoint adjustments in various levels.
[*] Disabled respawn during spell tutorial level.
[*] ESC now let's you leave TP Interaction with girls started through PhysicsProximityEnabler.
[*] Removed options from the Merchant Inventory that do nothing.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Potentially fixed VR height issues in cutscenes and made recalibration (from headset) mid cutscene work.
[*] Potentially fixed crash issues related to Spell upgrade UI.
[*] Fixed orbs, gold, health, mana and spell upgrades being reset to zero when switching between TP and VR mid playthrough.
[*] Fixed mismatching textures in nude patch girls.
[*] Fixed nude patch girls reseting to default look above waist.
[*] Fixed continue button being grayed out on fisrt start of game in VR until you open and close a sub-menu.
[*] Fixed double tap dodge not being affected by key rebinds.
[*] Fixed various issues related to the spark spell tutorial.
[*] Fixed Brianna follower not having the correct outfit in Lexi route.
[*] Fixed Lexi not being nude in some levels with Nude patch enabled.
[*] Fixed enemies being able to attack you during some interactions in game.
[*] Fixed player not having hands during some VR scenes.
[*] Fixed lighting artefacts in various places.
[*] Fixed navigation issues in Lexi route.
[*] Fixed Jenna Missing textures in guild hall scene.
[*] Fixed well mesh in Village not having collision in VR.
[*] Fixed weird textures in interactive sex pawn.
[*] Fixed some spiders and wolves turning green or red when being slowed.
[*] Fixed Merchant's chest blocking the Merchant's Inventory UI in VR.
[*] Potentialy fixed black screen in Village level.
[*] Fixed wrong loadings screens being used when loading Cursed lands and Cursed lands church through the Chapters Menu.
[*] Fixed a few enemies blocking the aoe spell telegraph.
[*] Fixed clipping issues in Lexi route.
[*] Fixed AOE spell telegraph being invisible on the water and ice in Lexi route.
[*] Fixed multiple instances of visible UI in loading screens.
[*] Fixed player being invisible at the start of the final battle in Lexi route.
[*] Fixed Erna rolling around on the ground.
[*] Fixed Erna camera position.
[*] Fixed incorrectly incrementing bosses defeated achievements.
[*] Fixed Bazaar Outro scene not unlocking in Jenna's scene gallery if you skipped the Bazaar Intro scene.
[*] Fixed face anim - Darick and Erika Guild hall Afterglow.
[*] Fixed followers getting stuck in some places.
[*] Fixed visible UI between the final cutscene and the loading screen in Jenna Route.
[*] Fixed reversed interactive sex in VR inputs.
[*] Fixed Jenna missing the dummy with her fireballs in Jenna Route Camp.
[*] Fixed visible UI between the final cutscene and the loading screen in Jenna Route.
[*] Fixed visible UI between the end of a cutscene and the loading screen in Cursed lands.
[*] Fixed visible UI between the scenes and between a scene and the loading screen in Erika Route.
[*] Fixed a worm's healthbar not updating in Erika Route. 
[*] Fixed player being invisible for a second after the scene in Erika Route.
[*] Fixed followers being far away when the battle at the end of Erika Route  starts. 
[*] Fixed player being invisible for a second after the end of the cutscene in Erika Route .
[*] Fixing Spider boss animation in Outro.
[*] Fixed camera being able to go inside the dummies in Guild hall garden.
[*] Various fixes to textures/materials.
[*] Fixes to Brianna's corrupted face anim.
[*] Fixed Assassins in Censored mode not dematerializing fully on death.
[*] Fixed player being in the resurect follower animation and being able to move after the Victory Cutscene if the player started resurecting a follower right before the scene.
[*] Fixed being able to use weapons and spells during cutscenes if you pause and unpause the game.
[*] Fixed being able to use weapons and spells during the Interview scene after pausing and unpausing the game.
[*] Fixed electric water not doing damage in certain parts of the frozen lake in Lexi Route.
[/list]
